Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a report of a side-impact collision at an itnersection in League City, Texas. Driver 1 was
proceeding through the intersection when Driver 2 entered from a crossing street and struck the driver's side of Driver
1's vehicle. A Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time of impact, and both the Passenger and Driver 1 were
present on scene when officers arrived. Driver 1 rpeorted neck and back strain and was evaluated by rseponding
medical personnel. The injury Driver 1 described is consistent with the forces typical of a side impact of this kind.
Driver 2 gave a statement that matched Driver 1's account of how the collision occurred. Two independent witnesses
described the same sequence of events, and scene photographs show damage concentrated along the driver's side,
which is largely consistent with the reported impact. Some faint scratches elsewhere on Driver 1's vehicle appear
older than this collision and were noted but not attributed to it. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy
covering the vehicle involved.
